detail.longDescription: RE: https:// mementomori.social/@Lupposofi/ 117172111153319697 In his commentary on Giles Howdle's P&T article on the anthropomorphization of AI, Johnny Sakr raises the topical concept of institutional anthropomorphic fallacy, which creates a lack of accountability, https:// link.springer.com/article/10.1 007/s13347-026-01173-7 Unfortunately, only the abstract is open access, but it is so well written that the message is probably conveyed. The underlying Howdle article is free, https:// link.springer.com/article/10.1 007/s13347-026-01133-1 Springer's Philosophy & Technology is also a source worth checking out from time to time, as is Ethics and Information Technology, https:// link.springer.com/journal/10676 (The three paragraphs above are a machine translation.)
